#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class FastReader {
public:
    FastReader() {}

    string nextLine() {
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        return line;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        return x;
    }
};

class TaskB {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, FastReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        string str;
        if (n > 0) {
            getline(cin, str); // consume newline after int
            if (str.empty()) getline(cin, str); // read actual line
        } else {
            getline(cin, str);
        }
        bool inside = false;
        bool inWord = false;
        int curLen = 0;
        int insideWords = 0;
        int maxLen = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = str[i];
            if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
                if (inWord) {
                    if (inside) insideWords++;
                    else if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
                    curLen = 0;
                    inWord = false;
                }
                if (c == '(') inside = true;
                else if (c == ')') inside = false;
            } else {
                if (!inWord) inWord = true;
                curLen++;
            }
        }
        if (inWord) {
            if (inside) insideWords++;
            else if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
        }
        out << maxLen << " " << insideWords;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastReader in;
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
